Title: New DCsv2-series virtual machines are now available

Body.Content:
Develop confidential applications that protect data while it’s being processed in the CPU with new DCsv2-series virtual machines (VMs), powered by Intel SGX. Traditionally, applications are protected while at rest and in transit. Now, you can deliver applications that protect data while in use. This enables a new set of scenarios like multiparty sharing, where it’s possible to combine data from multiple companies to run machine learning models without the companies getting access to each other’s data.

Benefits of the DCsv2-Series include:

  • Three initial regions.
  • Region expansion before the end of 2020.
  • SDK available to code applications that benefit from confidentiality.
  • Lift-and-shift options available through third-party partners like Anjuna, Fortanix, and Anqlave.

Learn more
